summary: Approved after adversarial review closed Git environment and replace-object redirection plus non-commit treeish acceptance; the immutable byte boundary is ready as a dormant B1 primitive.

findings.summary: Inherited Git environment variables and replace refs could redirect the index or object bytes.
Mutable refs and bare subtree IDs were accepted where an exact commit OID was required.

limitations: Ubuntu CI must run the symlink regression without a skip; B2 must reject malformed syntax, invalid encodings, unacceptable semantics, and an empty inventory; activation must supply the authoritative resolved base commit; add a Git subprocess wall-clock timeout before use on arbitrary user repositories.
